exec(open('lib.py').read())
import scipy.special as sp, os
def gelu(x): return 0.5*x*(1+sp.erf(x/np.sqrt(2)))
Zp=np.load('pass_10/token_hidden_L1.npy'); msk=np.load('pass_10/attention_mask.npy').astype(bool)
Z=Zp[msk].astype(np.float64); sent=np.repeat(np.arange(64)[:,None],Zp.shape[1],1)[msk]
P='bert.encoder.layer.0.'
X=Z*base(P+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight')+base(P+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias')
W1=base(P+'intermediate.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); bb1=base(P+'intermediate.dense.bias')
W2=base(P+'output.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); bb2=base(P+'output.dense.bias')
A=gelu(X@W1.T+bb1); F=A@W2.T+bb2
tr=sent%2==0; te=~tr
S=X+F; Sden=np.linalg.norm(S[te]-S[te].mean(0))**2
def fit_eval(keep,lam):
    As=A[:,keep]; mu=As[tr].mean(0); Fm=F[tr].mean(0)
    Ac=As[tr]-mu; Fc=F[tr]-Fm; W0=W2[:,keep].T
    Wn=np.linalg.solve(Ac.T@Ac+lam*np.eye(len(keep)), Ac.T@Fc+lam*W0); b=Fm-mu@Wn
    pred=As@Wn+b; e=np.linalg.norm(pred[te]-F[te])**2
    return e/np.linalg.norm(F[te]-F[te].mean(0))**2, e/Sden
Ac=A[tr]-A[tr].mean(0)
G=Ac.T@Ac
en=A[tr].var(0)*(W2**2).sum(0)
for lam in [10,100]:
    Ginv=np.linalg.inv(G+lam*np.eye(3072))
    obs=(W2**2).sum(0)/np.diag(Ginv)
    for m in [768,1024,1536]:
        ko=np.sort(np.argsort(-obs)[:m]); ke=np.sort(np.argsort(-en)[:m])
        print('lamsel',lam,'m',m,'OBS',['%.3f/%.4f'%fit_eval(ko,l) for l in [30,100,300]],' energy',['%.3f/%.4f'%fit_eval(ke,l) for l in [30,100,300]])
